intent: Independently review the attached Esteban GEO Capture 20 build brief and current worktree. Identify blocking factual, citation-measurement, accessibility, or server-rendering risks. Do not edit files, publish, submit forms, or contact external parties. Return a short actionable review and verdict.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The review is restricted to existing page and contact-control repairs. It must assess whether added choice controls preserve the current editorial hierarchy rather than approving a new composition.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Fuente: «No emojis los odio es una regla solo se usan cuando explícitamente los pido». También rechazó los emojis del navegador superior antes de esta corrección.
visual_evidence.comparison: The current phone reference is a baseline only. The reviewer must not approve unbuilt code from it; the eventual candidate must preserve short mobile reading, a visible direct action, and server-served facts without clutter.

brief.visitor: A buyer comparing existing Esteban editing or event options after AI/search discovery.
brief.promise: The review protects factual, accessible, existing-route improvements from unsupported citation or outcome claims.
brief.primary_action: Review the evidence-bounded change set and report blocking defects before release.
brief.friction: Citation observations can be misrepresented as customer outcomes, while optional UI controls can accidentally obscure the direct contact path.

kpi.outcome: qualified inquiries with a persisted discovery source
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: outcome measurement has not yet been collected
kpi.readout: T+7, T+28, and T+56 separated by discovery source
kpi.decision_rule: reject any change that fabricates proof, leaks lead content, or blocks a source-tagged direct inquiry

concept.idea: A narrow evidence and interaction audit of small route/contact repairs.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban's existing visual system stays intact; no new generic landing-page language or interface is needed.
concept.interaction: Review selected/unselected source and delivery choices against the direct contact path.
concept.visible_response: The review identifies whether choices are readable and whether the route still has an obvious next action.
concept.direct_path: The existing contact action must remain available without choosing optional depth.
concept.alternatives: Reject a new city route, chatbot, page-volume batch, or citation promise.

story.action: Inspect claim, measurement, raw-HTML, and accessibility risks.
story.consequence: Report concrete blockers or approval limits.
story.next_step: Return findings to the build/QA path.

content.visible: Factual source and delivery choices with an immediate existing contact action.
content.optional_html: Native details only for verified operational depth.
content.linked_depth: Existing Esteban routes retain deeper service and preparation information.

references.borrow: Existing Esteban phone hierarchy and shared component interaction conventions.
references.avoid: Emoji, unsupported proof, client-only answer text, and decorative clutter.

components.reuse: Existing contact, analytics, and shared Rail/common primitives.
components.local_reason: A local chooser is acceptable only when it persists the required contact semantics and has no equivalent shared primitive.

verification.rendered_states: Assess phone, short-phone, and desktop selected/unselected states when a candidate exists.
verification.motion: No new motion is needed and it must not gate words or action.
verification.accessibility_performance: Check labels, keyboard behavior, touch spacing, and direct-path visibility.
verification.raw_html: Confirm facts and optional details are present in initial server HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Confirm a fixture or authorized test path, never a customer submission, proves payload shape.

reviewers.behavior: cto-qa-lead verifies persistence, analytics, and raw HTML.
reviewers.outcome: cto-growth-lead reads attributable inquiry evidence after release.

learning.metric: qualified inquiry submissions with a persisted discovery source
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: source-tagged qualified inquiries are unmeasured
learning.hypothesis: A factual choice repair makes future inquiry sources measurable without adding page volume.
learning.decision_rule: retain only source-backed changes with no completion-quality regression
learning.registration_condition: record the exact events and first comparable post-release read before judging outcome
